title: 第1027章 生命禁区亡者国度第1026章 亡者之路
lines: 无数细密的空间碎片如同最锋利的刀片，切割着他的身体，发出“嗤嗤”的声响，
留下道道深可见骨、却诡异地没有鲜血流出的伤痕！
那些扭曲哀嚎的怨魂残影，更是如同附骨之疽，
疯狂地冲击着他的识海，试图撕裂他的神魂，
将他也同化为这死寂通道中的一部分！
“主宰！”
紧随其后的骨狱魔尊发出惊骇的意念。
它看到林烬的身体在瞬间变得灰败，气息如同风中残烛般急剧衰落，
心中那最后一丝对“主宰无敌”的幻想彻底破灭！
取而代之的是深深的恐惧和一丝…源自本能的贪婪？
如果这位“主宰”真的死在这里…那它们体内的禁制…？
幽影魔尊的阴影之躯在狂暴的死气中扭曲不定，
它感受着林烬急速衰弱的生机，幽紫魂火剧烈闪烁，心思电转：
“好可怕的死气侵蚀！他果然无法完全免疫！这是机会…还是更大的陷阱？”
它对那血脉禁制的恐惧，让它不敢轻举妄动，
但看着林烬痛苦挣扎的样子，一个阴暗的念头却在滋生。
噬魂魔尊的无数怨魂面孔则露出了极度兴奋和贪婪的神色！
它感觉林烬那蕴含着九狱炎骨神性的、正在被死气侵蚀的灵魂，
对它而言是前所未有的美味！
“嘎嘎…痛苦吧！挣扎吧！你的灵魂…终将…”
它无声地尖啸着，若非禁制束缚，它恨不得立刻扑上去吞噬！
林烬此刻已无暇顾及三魔的心思。
他感觉自己如同掉入冰窟的溺水者，意识都在冰冷的侵蚀下变得模糊。
他疯狂地运转《九狱尊诀》，试图调动焚荒神力抵抗，
但神力在死气面前如同投入烈火的水滴，瞬间被冻结、湮灭！
九狱炎骨血脉在死气的刺激下本能地沸腾，
散发出赤金神光，试图驱逐入侵的腐朽力量。
然而，这血脉之力如同被封印的猛兽，虽然强大，
却缺乏有效的引导和掌控，只能被动地护住核心心脉和神魂，
无法完全阻挡死气的全面入侵。
“地狱…熔炉！”
在意识即将沉沦的刹那，林烬几乎是凭着本能，发出了最后的嘶吼！
七道微弱却无比坚韧的赤金色光芒，猛地从他丹田处透体而出！
七尊微缩的、布满了古老符文的地狱熔炉虚影，瞬间在他周身浮现、旋转！
content_en:
Countless fine space fragments were like the sharpest blades, cutting into his body, making a "chichi" sound.
It left scars that were deep enough to show the bones, but strangely no blood flowed out!
Those twisted and wailing residual images of resentful souls are like gangrene attached to the bones,
Frantically attacking his sea of consciousness, trying to tear his soul apart,
Assimilate him into a part of this dead passage!
"Lord!"
The Bone Hell Demon Lord who followed closely behind issued a horrified thought.
It saw Lin Jin's body turning gray in an instant, and his breath fading rapidly like a candle in the wind.
The last illusion in my heart about the "invincible master" was completely shattered!
Replaced by deep fear and a hint of... instinctive greed?
If this "Master" really died here...then what's the restriction in their bodies...?
The shadow body of the Shadow Demon Lord twists and turns in the violent death energy,
It felt Lin Jin's rapidly declining vitality, the purple soul fire flashed violently, and its mind was spinning:
"What a terrifying death energy erosion! He is indeed not completely immune! Is this an opportunity... or a bigger trap?"
Its fear of the bloodline restriction makes it dare not act rashly,
But looking at Lin Jin struggling in pain, a dark thought was growing.
The faces of countless resentful souls of the Soul-Eating Demon Lord showed expressions of extreme excitement and greed!
It felt that Lin Jin's soul, which contained the divinity of the Nine Hell Flame Bones and was being corroded by the death energy,
It tastes better than ever before!
"Quack... suffer! Struggle! Your soul... will eventually..."
It screamed silently, and if it weren't for the restraint, it would have pounced on it and swallowed it!
Lin Jin had no time to care about the thoughts of the three demons at this moment.
He felt like a drowning man falling into an ice cave, his consciousness blurred by the cold erosion.
He ran the "Nine Hell Master Techniques" frantically, trying to mobilize Fenhuang's divine power to resist,
But in the face of the death energy, the divine power is like water droplets thrown into the fire, instantly frozen and annihilated!
The blood of the Nine Hell Flame Bones boils instinctively under the stimulation of death energy,
Emitting red gold divine light, trying to expel the invading corrupt power.
However, the power of this bloodline is like a sealed beast. Although it is powerful,
However, it lacks effective guidance and control and can only passively protect its core heart and soul.
It is impossible to completely block the full invasion of death energy.
"Hell... the furnace!"
At the moment when his consciousness was about to sink, Lin Jin let out his final roar almost based on instinct!
Buzz—!
Seven weak but extremely tough red-gold rays of light suddenly burst out from his dantian!
Seven miniature phantoms of the Hell Furnace covered with ancient runes appeared and rotated around him in an instant!
